Fe/Al remover.gain_basis: cuts Ni/Co lost in Fe/Al hydroxide cake (~1–3% of payable metal)

Fluoride sorbent.gain_basis: F⁻ removal is a minor reagent/filter step today (Ca/Al precipitation)

Nickel binder.gain_basis: replaces Ni SX or crystallization stage: ~1/4 of SX cost

Manganese precipitant.gain_basis: replaces Mn D2EHPA SX stage, the smallest-value metal

Rare-earth separator.gain_basis: separation ~15–20% of NdPr cost; better extractant halves mixer stages

Lithium catcher.market_what: brine lithium output value, ~30% of 240 kt Li at $14k/t LCE, 2024

Copper leach booster.gain_basis: extra recovery from chalcopyrite heaps; Freeport targets +800 Mlb/yr from additives

Cathode metal scavenger.gain_basis: trace Cu/Fe/Al cleanup of precursor liquor; existing resins mostly work

TMAH recovery.gain_basis: on-site reuse replaces fresh TMAH + disposal at part of fab volume

Iron mobiliser.market_what: geologic/stimulated H₂ spend per year (Koloma $394M raised; DOE $20M)

Lignin catalyst.gain_basis: lignin-to-aromatics not commercial; most lignin is burned for energy

Siloxane catcher.gain_basis: regenerable media vs single-use carbon change-outs

CO₂ capture.gain_basis: less water uptake cuts regeneration energy, ~30% of DAC opex

Xenon catcher.gain_basis: small capture units add supply outside giant cryogenic plants
